landing_pull.force_semantics: fixed initial heading plus world up; COM force and r-cross-F equivalent torque
landing_pull.point_semantics: model base mesh AABB front/top at lateral center; uncalibrated hardware attachment
landing_pull.trigger_semantics: all four contacts below threshold for airborne interval, then both wheels above; next physics step; episode zero only

physics_window.force_semantics: net normal contact force averaged over the just-completed physics step; excludes friction
physics_window.torque_semantics: PD computed/applied drive torque for the just-completed physics step; excludes passive impact load
physics_window.velocity_semantics: wheel link origin (axle center) velocity in world frame; negative z means descending

motion_diagnostics.reference_timing: frame commanded for this action; not next observation frame
motion_diagnostics.torque_sampling: final physics substep of each control step
